references.text: Moses gave land to the half-tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan, along with Gad and Reuben
The descendants of Manasseh conquered areas in Gilead and Bashan
Moses gave the entire Bashan region to the half-tribe of Manasseh
Joshua reminds the half-tribe of Manasseh that Moses gave them land east of the Jordan
The half-tribe of Manasseh returns to their territory east of the Jordan
The clans and descendants of Manasseh who received an inheritance
The half-tribe of Manasseh settled in the land from Bashan to Baal-Hermon
